erpax.comment: The site is the connector: /api/mcp is @payloadcms/plugin-mcp, a gateway onto the same collections the REST API serves. Set ERPAX_MCP_URL=http://localhost:3000/api/mcp to use a local server. The key decides access and tenant scope.

trello.comment: OFF by default (disabled: true). Scaffolded for an AGENT holding a conversation about a board — NOT for the sync path, which goes through the typed REST client in src/trello so write ordering, the rate-limit budget and typed errors stay observable. Enable by setting TRELLO_MCP_ENABLED=1 and flipping disabled to false. The token grants full Trello account access.
